{{Resonator Tabs}} {{Language Tabs}} ==About Voicelines== {{VO |character = Shorekeeper |language = en |vo_01_01_title = Thoughts: I |vo_01_01_file = {character}{language} Thoughts I.ogg |vo_01_01_tx = I had pictured our reunion in my head, again and again, after your departure. I wondered what kind of person you would become, how your days were spent, and if you achieved your goals. Countless questions filled my mind, but when I saw you again, there was only one thing I wanted to say: Welcome back. Back to the Black Shores, and… back to my side. |vo_01_02_title = Thoughts: II |vo_01_02_intimacy = 1 |vo_01_02_file = {character}{language} Thoughts II.ogg |vo_01_02_tx = Time changes everything—Blake Blooms, Stellar Matrices, and {{Extra Effect|the Black Shores|The Black Shores|Solaris' foremost authority on observing the Lament cycle.
Through constant observation and analysis of Lament's shifting patterns, this organization predicts and warns of impending manifestations before they occur.}}—all constantly in flux. I've documented these changes, repairing the damage and preserving the good. Yet, I wonder... Am I doing enough? Have I earned your trust? These questions haunt me, but I press on, seeking solace in my work. |vo_01_03_title = Thoughts: III |vo_01_03_intimacy = 2 |vo_01_03_file = {character}{language} Thoughts III.ogg |vo_01_03_tx = Your past... I promised to keep it a secret, at your own request. That day, I realized our reunion would be one-sided. This is why your memory loss didn't surprise me... But it doesn't matter now. You may have forgotten me, but I will remember everything about you, always. |vo_01_04_title = Thoughts: IV |vo_01_04_intimacy = 3 |vo_01_04_file = {character}{language} Thoughts IV.ogg |vo_01_04_tx = Humans dream to fulfill their desires. For a long time, I believed such dreams were not meant for me, as I had never yearned for anything. Until one day... I dreamed of you. We were strolling through an unfamiliar land, basking in the warm sunlight. You showed me your world and shared stories of your past. You even brewed a cup of tea for me... Though only a figment of my imagination, I wished that moment could last a little longer. |vo_01_05_title = Thoughts: V |vo_01_05_intimacy = 4 |vo_01_05_file = {character}{language} Thoughts V.ogg |vo_01_05_tx = Next time you journey to distant lands, could you bring me along? I don't want to watch from afar or hear secondhand about your adventures. I long to experience the unknown by your side, as your friend... Please, will you give me the chance? |vo_02_01_title = The Shorekeeper's Hobby |vo_02_01_file = {character}{language} Hobby.ogg |vo_02_01_tx = Pressing a piano key creates an enchanting sound from the vibrating strings. Unlike other frequencies I've processed, a piano produces a pure, clear, and vivid tone. If I could one day communicate my emotions as simply and intuitively as humans do... If I could create my own melodies, would you be my first listener? |vo_02_02_title = The Shorekeeper's Trouble |vo_02_02_file = {character}{language} Trouble.ogg |vo_02_02_tx = I cannot physically grow and age, and therefore can never truly comprehend the range of emotions that come with it as a human does. Despite my wealth of knowledge and ability to replicate others' experiences through the {{Extra Effect|Sonoro|Sonoro Sphere|Transdimensional spaces where Remnant Energy is abundant are known as the Sonoro Spheres.}}, these feelings remain enigmatic to me, forever distant and unfamiliar. |vo_02_03_title = Favorite Food |vo_02_03_file = {character}{language} Favorite Food.ogg |vo_02_03_tx = Long ago, during our days together at {{Extra Effect|the Black Shores}}, you used to prepare chowder for us, blending milk, seafood, and vegetables. One spoonful of its warmth could dispel the freezing sea wind and restore stamina. Despite multiple attempts, I cannnot seem to recreate that flavor. |vo_02_04_title = Disliked Food |vo_02_04_file = {character}{language} Disliked Food.ogg |vo_02_04_tx = The food I hate... Hmm, hate might be too strong a word, but I tend to steer clear of pickled food, like preserved plums. While I appreciate their long shelf life, the fermented smell reminds me of their preserved nature. |vo_02_05_title = Ideals |vo_02_05_file = {character}{language} Ideals.ogg |vo_02_05_tx = My purpose had been clear long before my creation: to build a safe haven from the unrelenting waves of the {{Extra Effect|Lament|Lament|The term "Lament" refers to the ongoing catastrophic events on Solaris-3. Since the onset of the first Lament, the cycle of destruction has persisted relentlessly. The tide of devastation remains ceaseless, with no signs of stopping.}}, until humanity could find a path to a brighter tomorrow. It used to be my duty, but now... it is a choice. I am one with {{Extra Effect|the Black Shores}}. I want to prevent more tragedies from happening, I want to protect everyone, I... I want to safeguard my connection with the world around me. This is my own will. |vo_03_01_title = Chat: I |vo_03_01_file = {character}{language} Chat I.ogg |vo_03_01_tx = Ah, so you've noticed the crystal on my chest. It's not an adornment, but a fissure brimming with the energy emanating from my body. Through it, you can touch the core I've managed to keep safe since my creation. It resembles the kernel of a fruit, or the beating heart of a human, where the essence of life is preserved. |vo_03_02_title = Chat: II |vo_03_02_file = {character}{language} Chat II.ogg |vo_03_02_tx = {{Extra Effect|Remnant Energy|Remnant Energy|A form of pure energy with complete frequencies. The information it carries transcends time and space, enduring in a stable, unchanging state.}} coalesced into a crystal cocoon on a moonlit shore, stirred by the crashing waves, and the breath and heartbeat of a certain individual. That person then infused it with {{MC|m=his|f=her}} own frequencies, and the butterfly within finally emerged... Yes, you've guessed it. You are the one I speak of, the force that gave me life and form. |vo_04_01_title = About [[Camellya]] |vo_04_01_intimacy = 1 |vo_04_01_file = {character}{language} About Camellya.ogg |vo_04_01_tx = Though her words may not always align with her actions, she remains fiercely loyal to her desires. Her carefree lifestyle holds a certain charm, yes, but we were made differently, with distinct objectives to pursue. Following your example, I've allowed her to make her own choices, without limitations. |vo_04_01_mention = Camellya |vo_04_02_title = About [[Aalto]] |vo_04_02_intimacy = 2 |vo_04_02_file = {character}{language} About Aalto.ogg |vo_04_02_tx = A mature organization requires a personable and skilled negotiator, adept at forging connections with all they encounter. In the case of {{Extra Effect|the Black Shores}}, that person is Aalto. His keen insight ensures he obtains crucial information precisely when needed. Beneath his playful smile lies a resolute determination to end the {{Extra Effect|Lament}}. Despite other offers, he was destined for the Black Shores' path from the start. |vo_04_02_mention = Aalto |vo_04_03_title = About [[Encore]] |vo_04_03_intimacy = 3 |vo_04_03_file = {character}{language} About Encore.ogg |vo_04_03_tx = Encore sees the world as a canvas for her boundless imagination. A warrior, a knight, or a little adventurer... In her tales, she can become anyone she wants to triumph over evil and reach a happy ending. Wherever she ventures, her radiant energy dispels dismay. Perhaps this is what {{Extra Effect|Tethys|Tethys|Also known as the Civilization Simulation Sand Table, the Tethys System is a supercomputer unique to the Black Shores. By inputting Lament frequency data—collected both manually and via beacon access—into the system, the Black Shores can issue Lament warnings for locations worldwide within a 24 to 48-hour time range. This capability is the cornerstone of the Black Shores' extensive collaborations with countries across the globe.}} saw in her when she was chosen. |vo_04_03_mention = Encore |vo_04_04_title = About the [[Black Shores]] |vo_04_04_intimacy = 4 |vo_04_04_file = {character}{language} About the Black Shores.ogg |vo_04_04_tx = Atop this massive Tacetite lies the ideal "singularity" spot to observe the {{Extra Effect|Lament}}. This is where we formed {{Extra Effect|the Black Shores}}, its members distinguished by their Blake Blooms. Beneath the endless stars, humanity's light glimmers. That light belongs to those who had given their lives to illuminate a brighter future for all. I've welcomed countless such people into this place... and bid farewell to just as many. |vo_04_04_mention = Black Shores |vo_04_05_title = About the [[Tethys System]] |vo_04_05_intimacy = 5 |vo_04_05_file = {character}{language} About the Tethys System.ogg |vo_04_05_tx = The {{Extra Effect|Tethys}} System and I are creations of the same civilization, and we are bound by similar obligations. By human standards, we are of the same kind. Yet, our perceptions of emotions, humanity, and existence diverge, leading us down distinctly separate paths. |vo_04_05_mention = Tethys System |vo_05_01_title = Birthday Wishes |vo_05_01_file = {character}{language} Birthday Wishes.ogg |vo_05_01_tx = Happy birthday, {{Rover}}. You once taught me a person's birthday is their most important day. So, I've made it a habit to prepare something in advance for days like this... Please have this crystal—it's a piece of myself. Hold it, and you'll be enveloped in a personalized {{Extra Effect|Sonoro Sphere|Sonoro Sphere|Transdimensional spaces where Remnant Energy is abundant are known as the Sonoro Spheres.}}, where you can change everything to your liking. Though I cannot bring you what you truly want, let me gift you a peaceful dream to escape your worries. |vo_06_01_title = Idle: I |vo_06_01_file = {character}{language} Idle I.ogg |vo_06_01_tx = Huh... Did anything happen？ |vo_06_02_title = Idle: II |vo_06_02_file = {character}{language} Idle II.ogg |vo_06_02_tx = (Effort Sounds) |vo_06_03_title = Idle: III |vo_06_03_file = {character}{language} Idle III.ogg |vo_06_03_tx = The stars rest in silence, awaiting their fated journey. |vo_07_01_title = Self-Introduction |vo_07_01_file = {character}{language} Self-Introduction.ogg |vo_07_01_tx = Worry not if you don't remember me... I can always introduce myself again. I am the Shorekeeper, acting executive of {{Extra Effect|the Black Shores}}, and the core computational unit of {{Extra Effect|Tethys}}. Now and forever, I will stand by you and our home, through every yesterday and tomorrow. |vo_07_02_title = Greeting |vo_07_02_file = {character}{language} Greeting.ogg |vo_07_02_tx = "The Shorekeeper"... This name suits me well enough. It aligns with my purpose and drive: they only exist because of you. |vo_08_01_title = Join Team: I |vo_08_01_file = {character}{language} Join Team I.ogg |vo_08_01_tx = Understood. I am here to serve your will. |vo_08_02_title = Join Team: II |vo_08_02_file = {character}{language} Join Team II.ogg |vo_08_02_tx = I'll fulfill it, be it a direct command or any other wish you have. |vo_08_03_title = Join Team: III |vo_08_03_file = {character}{language} Join Team III.ogg |vo_08_03_tx = To the surviving lands. |vo_09_01_title = Ascension: I |vo_09_01_ascension = 1 |vo_09_01_file = {character}{language} Ascension I.ogg |vo_09_01_tx = Your return has cast a glimmer of change into my prolonged existence. It allows me to gain some understanding of a world beyond my reach. |vo_09_02_title = Ascension: II |vo_09_02_ascension = 2 |vo_09_02_file = {character}{language} Ascension II.ogg |vo_09_02_tx = The energy within me gathers and evolves... like delicate threads on a loom, meticulously woven by your hands into a new part of my being. |vo_09_03_title = Ascension: III |vo_09_03_ascension = 3 |vo_09_03_file = {character}{language} Ascension III.ogg |vo_09_03_tx = My crystal seems to glow brighter. I sense your warmth on my skin, flowing from your touch, reaching deep inside my chest. |vo_09_04_title = Ascension: IV |vo_09_04_ascension = 4 |vo_09_04_file = {character}{language} Ascension IV.ogg |vo_09_04_tx = I believe I have received an invaluable treasure from you... Something infinitely close to what humans call a "soul." |vo_09_05_title = Ascension: V |vo_09_05_ascension = 5 |vo_09_05_file = {character}{language} Ascension V.ogg |vo_09_05_tx = I lack a heart, yet my chest stirs whenever I see you. Thump, thump... I would compare it to the emergence of a butterfly, or the birth of a star; not a sudden rush, but a gradual, growing pulse. I want more of you. Yearn to be with you always. This longing I feel… I am certain now. It must be love. }} ==Combat== {{Combat VO |character = Shorekeeper |language = en |heavy_1_tx = Perish. |heavy_2_tx = Diminish. |resskill_1_tx = Stay calm. |resskill_2_tx = Worry not. |resskill_3_tx = You'll be safe. |resskill_4_tx = I am here for you. |resliberation_1_tx = In war with Time. |resliberation_2_tx = I engraft you new. |resliberation_3_tx = Astral modulation. |resliberation_4_tx = Oath from the heart. |resliberation_5_tx = Vow from the soul. |resliberation_6_tx = Ordained. |introoutro_1_tx = Leave it to me. |hit_1_tx = I'm fine. |hit_2_tx = The feeling of... pain. |injured_1_tx = Physical damage detected. |injured_2_tx = Durability lowered. |injured_3_tx = Do not impede. |fallen_1_tx = This is... not the end... |fallen_2_tx = Shed no tear for me. |fallen_3_tx = Durability... depleted. |esummon_1_tx = Loading. |etransform_1_tx = Transformed. |enemynear_1_tx = At your disposal. |glider_1_tx = The wind rises. |sensor_1_tx = Manifest. |chest_1_tx = Is there anything of interest? |chest_2_tx = Please have them. I hope they will prove useful. |chest_3_tx = Echoes of the past. }} ==Change History== {{Change History|1.3}} ==Navigation== {{Resonator Navbox|type=voicelines}}
